Chapter 6449: Older Generation’S Feud

Chapter 6449: Older Generation’s Feud

“My grandfather.” Bronze said.

“Oh, so you’re Seventy-two Origin Ancestor’s son.” Li Qiye said.

In the past, the origin ancestor’s son displayed incredible talent at a young age. Thus, his father beseeched Poye to help him obtain a peerless eye.

This greatly improved Bronze’s cultivation speed, making him one of the youngest primal ancestors in Old World.

Bronze was surprised because those related to his grandfather were all ancient ancestors such as Gao Yang.

“Young Noble, you and my grandfather...” He asked.

“Let the past be the past once fate fades.” Li Qiye interrupted him.

He had met Poye and other masters before. However, this ordinary-looking man was difficult to describe - a truly enigmatic being.

“Then maybe fate brought us together again today.” Bronze said without confidence.

“I have heard of your father’s legends.” Li Qiye said.

This could be construed as praise but it sounded different when it came from Li Qiye.

“His dao path was bumpy.” Bronze said softly.

“No path is truly paved.” Li Qiye said: “It is going against the heaven, challenges are expected.”

“The challenge is not the main issue, it is your father’s blind hatred in going against Desolate Ancestor.” The skull chuckled.

“...” Bronze paused briefly before responding: “As a junior, I dare not look down on his suffering and its result.”

“Did Desolate Ancestor ever try to kill your father?” The skull asked.

“No.” He shook his head.

“I just happen to know a bit regarding this mess.” The skull smiled: “Your father hated Desolate Ancestor yet still became the second primal ancestor, a path she started. If the brat had taught him, why didn’t he go that route?”

“Because Immortal Sansheng’s path can only be walked by him.” He said.

“Then his anger was misplaced. His accomplishment was due to her generosity. His cultivation only existed because of her. Thus, it’s rather hilarious that he hates her.” The skull said.

“I dare not comment on the seniors’ feud and grievances.” He said.

“Your father is alive right now due to the seniors’ protection.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, Desolate Ancestor brought your grandparents to see me before, Three-eyed Prodigy and his wife. What a shame, a whole family destroyed because of stupidity.” The skull said.

“Did my clan deserve to be destroyed?” Bronze asked.

“Brat, your vision is limited. Given your clan’s choice, all of your race would have been eradicated. However, your grandparents were clever and gave your clan a breath of life to continue the lineage. Otherwise, you and your father would not be around right now.” The skull said.

Bronze knew quite a bit about the feud but it wasn’t his place to comment. His father hated Desolate Ancestor because after his grandparents died in battle fighting for Desolate Ancestor, his father was expelled from the dao lineage.

His father attributed his suffering to Desolate Ancestor. However, everything started with God Eye Progenitor who tried to kill Desolate Ancestor first. His grandparents could not change the progenitor’s decision.

Her rumored death infuriated numerous powerful cultivators such as Everlasting Jiang and other ancient ancestors. Members of Life and Death Heaven wanted to destroy God Eye System.

She somehow survived the ordeal and returned stronger, killing three progenitors afterward. She spared the system out of respect for Three-eyed Prodigy and his wife. Nevertheless, the animosity couldn’t be erased.

“It’s his personal issue.” Li Qiye patted Bronze’s shoulder.

“Desolate Ancestor just needed to say the word if she wanted to end your bloodline. It didn’t matter whether your father was in Moshi’s favor or not.” The skull said: “You were spared because of your grandparents’ effort and ties.”

This was indeed the case because with her command, a supreme overlord from Life and Death Heaven could have descended and destroyed them.

Moreover, his father participated in the killing of Xianting. However, Supreme Black Ancestor only suppressed his cultivation as a warning.

“His hatred will not subside.” Bronze said.

“Just because she didn’t help him when he was banished?” Li Qiye chuckled.

“I don’t know.” Bronze said but deep down, he knew this was a driving force.

“One can only hate when they’re strong enough, otherwise, it’s a needless source of frustration.” Li Qiye said.

“I can’t change his mind.” He said sincerely.

“Then leave it to fate. When it’s time to go meet the king of hell, no one can prevent it.” Li Qiye said.

“Young Noble, you mean...” He became startled.

“He means to run back home.” The skull said: “Your father is only an insect courting death. If he continues to be blind, your grandparents’ sacrifice won’t be enough to save him or you.”
